name: Krysiny Yad
source:
Semyon is lonely. He has a hard time making contact with the outside world, and he has no luck with girls. But one day, he finds a similarly lonely, downtrodden creature - a kitten. It seems life is getting a little better, but the world is unlikely to leave them in peace.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1754937757]Steam[/url]]
translation:
谢苗很孤独。他很难与外界接触，也没有女孩缘。但有一天，他发现了一只同样孤独、受压迫的动物——一只小猫。生活似乎有所好转，但世界不太可能让他们安宁。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1754937757]Steam[/url]]
